description: Source code for a Zephyr-based modem backend implementation using TTY interface, including thread routines, open/close, transmit/receive functions, and initialization.

methods.name: modem_backend_tty_routine
methods.description: Thread routine handling polling and data reception for TTY backend.

methods.name: modem_backend_tty_open
methods.description: Opens the TTY device, starts the thread, and notifies that the device is opened.

methods.name: modem_backend_tty_transmit
methods.description: Transmits data over the TTY device.

methods.name: modem_backend_tty_receive
methods.description: Receives data from the TTY device.

methods.name: modem_backend_tty_close
methods.description: Closes the TTY device, stops the thread, and notifies closure.

methods.name: modem_backend_tty_init
methods.description: Initializes the TTY backend structure with configuration and returns the pipe.
